candidates.name: Cable Goblet Squat
candidates.cardText:
Cable Goblet Squat
Novice
1
Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
2
Get your elbows directly underneath the bar, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
3
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
4
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

candidates.name: Cable Split Squat
candidates.cardText:
Cable Split Squat
Advanced
1
You can use a straight or EZ bar on this exercise. Cable should be set all to the bottom.
2
Grab the attachment and walk back a few steps. Take a split stance. One leg in front and one behind.
3
Break at the knees and hips to initiate the split squat. Make sure your back knee touches the floor.
4
Squat back up into a standing position.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Leg Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Leg Extension
Advanced
1
Stand upright facing away from the cable crossover with the cable set to the height of your hips. Use an ankle/wrist attachment.
2
Extend at the knee against the cable.

candidates.name: Cable Thruster
candidates.cardText:
Cable Thruster
Beginner
1
Hold low cable handles at shoulder height with your feet shoulder-width apart.
2
Squat down while keeping your chest raised and knees tracking outward.
3
Stand powerfully and press both handles overhead until your arms are extended.

candidates.name: Cable Belt Squat
candidates.cardText:
Cable Belt Squat
Beginner
1
Put on a dip belt. Attach the strap/chain to the cable's carabiner.
2
Take a few steps back. Begin to squat by flexing at the knees and hips.
3
Let the weight pull you forward as you squat. Then push your toes through the front of your shoes as you squat back to the start position.

candidates.name: Cable Belt Split Squat
candidates.cardText:
Cable Belt Split Squat
Beginner
1
Put on a dip belt and attach the strap/ chain to the cable's carabiner.
2
Take a few steps back and take a split stance.
3
Lower into a split squat, letting the weight pull you forward. As you squat back to the starting position push yourself backwards against the resistance.

candidates.name: Cable Seated Leg Extension
candidates.cardText:
Cable Seated Leg Extension
Beginner
1
Use an ankle/wrist attachment. Pull the cable under the bench and attach it at your ankle.
2
Extend at the knee against the cable.

candidates.name: Cable Zercher Squat
candidates.cardText:
Cable Zercher Squat
Intermediate
1
Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
2
Place the bar in your elbows, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
3
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
4
Squat all the way back to a standing position.
